name: Interpersonal Needs Questionnaire (INQ-15)
rights: FSU Joiner Lab directly distributes the INQ-15, and peer-reviewed clinical measurement literature describes the INQ as freely available in the public domain.

perceived_burdensomeness.method: Mean or sum items 1–6; retain chosen metric consistently.

thwarted_belongingness.method: Reverse items 7, 8, 10, 13, 14, and 15 (1↔7, 2↔6, 3↔5, 4 unchanged), then mean or sum items 7–15.

safety_note: INQ-15 measures interpersonal constructs associated with suicidal desire. Scores are not an individual suicide-risk probability or a safe/unsafe classification; concerning responses require direct human assessment under the approved protocol.
